title: session banner says feedback 'rides to the maintainers', but nothing leaves the repo without an export or a configured sink
detail: gate.py session-start context tells an adopter that filed findings ride to the maintainers. report.export_payload and feedback._push_to_sink show nothing is transmitted unless the adopter runs an export or sets feedback_sink. A security reviewer reading the banner would conclude data leaves automatically, which contradicts SECURITY.md and the no-telemetry promise.
